selfLove.moodBasedSubtitle: This affirmation is personalized for how you're feeling right now

excellent: I celebrate my joy and share my positive energy with the world.
I am grateful for this moment of happiness and abundance.
My enthusiasm and optimism are contagious and uplifting.
I deserve to feel this amazing and I embrace it fully.
I use this positive energy to create even more wonderful experiences.
good: I am worthy of love and kindness, especially from myself.
I choose to focus on the positive aspects of my life.
I am doing my best, and that is enough.
I radiate positivity and attract good things into my life.
I am proud of myself for showing up today.
okay: I accept myself exactly as I am in this moment.
It's okay to feel neutral - not every day needs to be extraordinary.
I am taking care of myself, one step at a time.
I trust the process of life and allow things to unfold naturally.
I am gentle with myself as I navigate this day.
low: I am allowed to have difficult days, and I deserve compassion.
This feeling is temporary, and brighter days are ahead.
I am stronger than I realize, even when I feel weak.
I reach out for support when I need it - that's a sign of strength.
I honor my feelings while knowing they don't define my worth.
anxious: I am safe right now in this present moment.
I breathe deeply and release the tension in my body.
I can handle uncertainty - I've overcome challenges before.
I let go of what I cannot control and focus on what I can.
My anxiety doesn't define me - I am so much more than this feeling.
neutral: I am enough just as I am.
I am growing and learning every day.
I release the need for self-criticism and embrace self-compassion.
I have the power to create the life I desire.
I trust myself and my journey.

defaultAffirmations: I am worthy of love and kindness, especially from myself.
I am enough just as I am.
I am growing and learning every day.
I release the need for self-criticism and embrace self-compassion.
I have the power to create the life I desire.

sleep.title: Prioritize Consistent Sleep Schedule
sleep.description: Your sleep duration of 6.5 hours is below the recommended 7-9 hours for adults, and you've identified 'Improve Sleep' as a goal. Inconsistent sleep can negatively affect mood, energy levels, and overall health. Establishing a regular sleep schedule can improve sleep quality and duration, leading to better mood, focus, and physical health.
actions: Set a consistent bedtime and wake-up time, even on weekends.
Create a relaxing bedtime routine (e.g., reading, taking a warm bath).
Avoid caffeine and alcohol before bed.
Ensure your bedroom is dark, quiet, and cool.

activity.title: Increase Daily Steps Towards Activity Goal
activity.description: Your daily step count of 4500 is below the recommended 10,000 steps, and you want to 'Be More Active.' Increasing your step count can improve cardiovascular health, boost energy levels, and aid in weight management.
actions: Set a daily step goal that is slightly higher than your current average (e.g., 5000 steps).
Incorporate short walks into your daily routine (e.g., during lunch breaks, after dinner).
Take the stairs instead of the elevator whenever possible.
Find an activity you enjoy, such as dancing or hiking, to make exercise more fun.

stress.title: Incorporate Stress-Reducing Techniques
stress.description: Your journal entry indicates feeling stressed at work. Managing stress is crucial for overall well-being. Incorporating stress-reducing techniques can improve mood, reduce anxiety, and enhance cognitive function.
actions: Extend your meditation time to 10-15 minutes daily.
Practice deep breathing exercises for a few minutes each day.
Take short breaks during work to stretch or walk around.
Consider engaging in a hobby you enjoy to unwind after work.

Consult a registered dietitian or nutritionist for personalized dietary advice.

greenSmoothie.name: Green Power Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Add spinach, banana, mango, and almond milk to blender
Blend until smooth and creamy
Pour into a bowl
Top with chia seeds, granola, berries, and coconut flakes
Serve immediately

grilledChicken.name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and herbs for 30 minutes
Preheat grill to medium-high heat
Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice
Arrange salad greens, tomatoes, and cucumber on plates
Top with sliced grilled chicken and drizzle with extra lemon juice

bakedSalmon.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C)
Place salmon and asparagus on a baking sheet
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic, salt, and pepper
Top salmon with lemon slices and dill
Bake for 15-20 minutes until salmon is cooked through
Serve immediately with lemon wedges

proteinPancakes.name: Protein-Packed Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until smooth
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake
Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form
Flip and cook for another 2 minutes
Top with berries, yogurt, and a drizzle of honey

quinoaBowl.name: Mediterranean Quinoa Buddha Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions
Roast chickpeas with olive oil and spices at 400°F for 20 minutes
Arrange quinoa in a bowl
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, feta, and olives
Add a dollop of hummus
Drizzle with lemon tahini dressing and serve

zucchiniNoodles.name: Zucchini Noodles with Marinara
instructions: Spiralize zucchini into noodles
Heat olive oil in a large pan
Sauté garlic for 1 minute
Add zucchini noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes
Add marinara sauce and heat through
Top with fresh basil, parmesan, and red pepper flakes

chiaPudding.name: Overnight Chia Seed Pudding
instructions: Mix chia seeds, almond milk, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar
Stir well to prevent clumping
Refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours
Stir before serving
Top with fresh berries, nuts, and coconut flakes

turkeyMeatballs.name: Turkey Meatballs with Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)
Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, and herbs
Form into 12-15 meatballs
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes
Steam or roast vegetables
Serve meatballs with vegetables and marinara sauce
